chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Jewish woman poisoned the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) in an arm, and the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) used to love the arm and the shoulder, and he disliked the hip due to its proximity to the urinating part.
ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) dislike eating the hip of the sheep?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* links the historical event of the poisoned sheep at Khaybar to the Prophet’s specific dietary preferences, noting he favored the arm and shoulder while avoiding the hip due to its proximity to the urinary organ. Scholars interpret this not merely as a physical preference but as a subtle indicator of the poison's location, highlighting the Prophet’s awareness and the practical wisdom in his eating habits.
